manifest_role: post-outcome scope and identity snapshot; not a pre-outcome preregistration

S0.role: Primary accepted shared FFT candidate (discovery run)

A.role: Ungated dual-core reference control (physically measured + repeated)

B.role: Power-managed dual-core control with characterized sky130_fd_sc_hd__dlclkp ICG cells
B.sparse_idle_measurement: not_available; do not extrapolate B into duty-cycle matrix

hypotheses.H1_power_managed_dual: Model-free clock-gated dual-core (Variant B) eliminates inactive core dynamic power, establishing a fair, power-managed comparison baseline against shared hardware.
hypotheses.H2_workload_breakeven: Shared hardware area advantage (33-34%) is invariant to workload; power/energy advantage depends on activity duty cycle and mode-switch frequency. A crossover point may exist at low active fractions if Variant B idle leakage/clock-cutoff is sufficiently low.
hypotheses.H3_thermal_concentration: Reduced total power does not unconditionally produce lower peak die temperature; spatial power concentration in a 33% smaller silicon footprint may alter the thermal profile depending on convective and conductive boundary conditions.
hypotheses.H4_evaluator_efficacy: Layered evaluation (lint, random oracle, directed holdouts, mapped GLS, STA, DRC, activity provenance) catches distinct error strata that cannot be detected by superficial metrics.

thermal_spec.fallback_rule: If spatial instance power map reconciles to >1% error from authoritative STA total, spatial hotspot claims are marked unavailable and a uniform-block model is used.
